subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public `before_tool_call` policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose, and which provenance/session facts are safe for ordinary plugins versus trusted policy plugins?
rationale: This defines a public Plugin SDK security-policy surface, and automation cannot choose the taxonomy, redaction boundary, or trust-tier visibility without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define unified policy facts
options.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

options.title: Land narrow provenance slices first
options.body: Accept narrower work such as external-content provenance while keeping this issue open for the broader action and input provenance design.

options.title: Defer hook enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape until the broader capability descriptor or Security Matrix model is settled.

recommendation.title: Define unified policy facts
recommendation.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The generic host-hook contract work is the closest existing SDK seam for a public trusted-policy and `before_tool_call` facts contract.
